messages:
jess: quick check — designing an SDK helper for func/tool output coercion. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/512

jess: TL;DR: we need deterministic behavior when model returns missing keys, null vs omitted vs wrong type. proposal: helper `coerceStruct(schema, payload, {treatNullAsMissing: true, defaultMissing: 'ignore'})` that returns normalized dict + list of warnings

tim: +1 on having explicit options. can we keep API tiny? maybe two helpers: `validate(schema,payload)` and `normalize(schema,payload,opts)`

sasha: important: streaming case — we might get partial objects then merged. helper should accept a `streamReconciler` hook so SDK can stitch partial chunks and surface intermediate warnings

mike: language notes: go should return `(struct, []ValidationError)` not exceptions. python/ruby can raise or return tuple. avoid swallowing errors in bindings

jess: question for devex: do we want SDK to auto-coerce numbers->strings? e.g., model returns `42` for string field, or `null` for optional list

dev-bot: deploy-checklist: don't forget to add unit tests for coercion + edgecases (null vs missing) :memo:

sasha: i'd avoid silent coercion. prefer explicit opts: `coercePrimitives: ['number->string']` and `strictNulls: false` so users opt-in/opt-out

tim: for runtime perf — default should not deep-validate huge nested schemas. maybe `shallowValidate` by default, `fullValidate` for CI/evals or when debug=true

jess: ack. action items:
- @tim add validate/normalize signatures to PR
- @sasha write streaming reconciliation API sketch
- @mike add language binding notes
- @jess add tests + examples

mike: ping @devex for API naming bikeshed

jess: ok i'll land basic shim behind feature flag, then iterate. thanks :heart:

sasha: fyi I'm leaving review comments on the PR

mike: LGTM once tests pass

jess: last ping — anyone object to default `treatNullAsMissing=true`? otherwise we'll break a bunch of clients

tim: no objections from me

sasha: no strong objections

mike: fine

jess: cool — landing tomorrow 09:00 PT unless I hear otherwise
